title: Protected media
description: Browse permanently saved evidence across your full retained history, including cameras no longer configured when your permissions allow.
leaseHint: Saved events protect original recordings permanently. Temporary playback and export leases only reserve media while a reader is active and are not included here.
invalidRange: The start date must not be after the end date.
loadError: Protected media could not be loaded. Try refreshing.
unknownSize_one: {{count}} recording has unknown size. The total is incomplete.
unknownSize_other: {{count}} recordings have unknown size. The total is incomplete.
metadataHint: Storage totals cover all matching events, not just this page. Shared recording segments are counted once per physical recording. Sizes and local availability use indexed metadata, not a live file check. Archive availability uses cached worker health, never a request-time NAS probe.
empty: No protected media matches these filters.

reason.saved_event: Permanently protected by a saved event

availability.archive_unavailable: Archive currently unavailable or health unknown. Evidence has not been marked deleted.
availability.missing: No original recording is indexed. A saved snapshot may still be available.
availability.deleting: An overlapping recording has a pending deletion. Playback is unavailable.

originalHint: Playback uses the original recording and requires browser support for its codecs. Export original preserves the recorded video and audio without lossy conversion.
playbackError: The original could not be played. It may be unavailable or its codecs may not be supported. Try exporting the original.
deleteBlocked: Protected media cannot be deleted. Remove permanent protection with confirmation first.
confirmDescription: This does not delete the event or its media. Normal retention, quota eviction and future lossy compression may now apply. Media can then be removed or changed automatically. Other saved events and active playback or export leases continue to protect overlapping recordings.
unprotectError: Protection could not be removed. Your permissions or the event may have changed. Refresh and try again.
